Photorealistic everyday portrait footage with soft morning daylight and natural skin texture. A softly blurred apartment entryway provides a simple background. The camera stays at eye level in a waist-up composition, leaving enough space above and beside her head for both hands and elbows.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> stands near the doorway, matching the character in <Picture 1>. Her hair is loose, with its original color and length preserved. A plain elastic hair tie sits around one wrist. She glances briefly toward a mirror positioned just beside the camera, then raises both hands toward the sides of her head.

During the first three seconds, she slides her fingers through her hair from the temples toward the back of her head, gathering it into a single bundle. Her elbows rise naturally on either side, and her chin tips down slightly. A few fine strands remain beside her cheeks. Her face stays visible between her raised arms, with a calm, lightly concentrated expression.

From three to seven seconds, she turns slightly into a three-quarter view. One hand holds the gathered hair at the back of her head while the other takes the elastic from her wrist. With a familiar, unhurried movement, she wraps the elastic around the bundle and secures a simple ponytail. She gently tightens it, then releases both hands. The ponytail drops and swings once before settling behind her neck.

During the final three seconds, she lowers her arms and turns her face back toward the camera. She smooths one loose strand beside her temple with her fingertips, then lets her hand fall. Her eyes lift toward the lens, and her concentrated expression softens into a small, satisfied smile. The shot ends as she shifts her shoulders slightly toward the doorway, ready to leave.
